note: The granularity mismatch is real and under-quantified, but failure-detection-for-segmentation literature is converging on it; the cross-model transfer test is what would set it apart.

Calibration-leads-accuracy is a testable lead-lag claim, but classification-side shift studies (Ovadia-style) have circled it; the deployment version needs label-free ECE proxies, an extra unproven step.
Instance-vs-pixel as separate supervision currencies with a measured exchange rate redirects long-tail data collection; within-class subsampling design neutralizes the semantics confound.
Uncertainty-sampling vs committee-disagreement routing is textbook active learning with decades of comparisons, including for segmentation; the Dice-per-hour dressing does not make it new.

Jitter/conflict decomposition is a clean idea that could rescue ensemble signals; boundary registration at large conflicts (own note) fails exactly at the informative extreme - needs a robust-matching answer upfront.

Class death as a predictable phase transition (with the no-revival-by-longer-training corollary) is a strong falsifiable law; config-dependence of the cliff is the main threat to universality. Lit-attacked below.
Conformal segmentation exists (own KNOWN note); the usability atlas with task-derived width budgets is the honest and useful delta, but it is an application study, not a discovery.
Boundary-band-excluded re-scoring of anomaly leaderboards is an afternoon of compute that could collapse a subfield's rankings; the both-views reporting requirement keeps it fair.

Referent-anchored validation of aleatoric/epistemic separation in segmentation is the exact program of recent uncertainty-validation frameworks (ValUES-style, ICLR 2024); the boundary-specific conflation figure is a subsection of that existing line.

A sign-changing calibration structure that global temperature provably cannot fix is a crisp claim; hierarchical estimation for rare-class reliability is the required statistical care. Good, not protected.
Same study as W2-A-0074 (its C08 restatement); keep 0074 as the canonical entry and kill the duplicate to avoid double-counting a single project.

Region-level abstention dominance is plausibly true and useful; selective-prediction-for-segmentation is an active area, so the granularity-predictor (from error autocorrelation) is the only defensible novelty.

'Uncertainty overlays can NET-INCREASE misses when calibration is poor' is a deployment-gating claim for the entire uncertainty-visualization agenda; automation bias is known in human factors but unmeasured here. Protect.

Bidirectional pasting cleanly separates context-prior from appearance deficit and would redirect long-tail research if the context side wins; pasting-artifact leakage (own note) is the known weakness of all copy-paste causal designs.
The validity envelope of consistency-based uncertainty is worth mapping; the online self-diagnosis claim is the ambitious part and the stochastic/systematic taxonomy is admittedly fuzzy at the edges.

One-GPU-day referee between free margins and expensive ensembles, with a practical hierarchy as output; per-class miscalibration interaction (ties to 0185) could confound the comparison and should be built in.

Severity-aware evaluation exists in hierarchical-metric form; the model-zoo absurdity profiling with the 'newer models err more absurdly' non-monotonicity claim is what could surprise. Semantic-distance contestability is the standing weakness.

Duplication-to-overconfidence causal path with a dedup-retrain leg is a solid contribution to data-centric uncertainty; retraining cost and the external-embedding neutrality requirement are the taxes.

What models emit in void zones is unexamined and deployment-relevant; evaluation without GT (consistency/downstream proxies only) is the soundness gap. Pairs with 0325's census as one ignore-region paper.

'Benchmark tails measure dataset redundancy, not capability' is a cheap, decisive, uncomfortable audit; embedding-choice replication is the only methodological demand. High kill-power over long-tail SOTA claims.
Onset-ordering of uncertainty signals is a second-order refinement of 0177; graded natural-weather data scarcity makes the decisive version infeasible and the synthetic version unconvincing.

Vocabulary-size confidence-decay law with a normalization fix addresses a silent incomparability every OV deployment hits; distractor-dependence of the law's parameters (own note) must be front and center.

Churn atlases matching human disagreement, plus the audit showing published gains concentrate on high-churn pixels, is a double-barreled result; churn is known in classification so the dense/audit legs carry novelty. Lit-attacked below.
Context-completion hallucination with association-strength dose-response is the segmentation analogue of LLM hallucination, quantified; dry-canal/drained-pool curation is tedious but entirely doable.

Frequency-resolved label-fault rates would partially dissolve the long-tail problem into an annotation-quality problem; classification label-error work (Northcutt line) gives the method a proven template, segmentation the open ground.
